scriptText:
I. PART I

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a dramatic, claustrophobic narrative scene inside a rainy highway diner late at night, featuring @actor1 as ROBERT (voice: @audio1), @actor2 as JOHN (voice: @audio2), and @actor3 as SARAH (voice: @audio3), where a surgeon's clinical cynicism and a mother's tactical micromanagement trigger a quiet standoff that pushes their withdrawn son toward the edge.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Ensure absolute spatial continuity across the East-to-West table axis, maintaining fixed character positions with John wedged against the West rain window, Sarah on the North aisle edge, and Robert centered on the South bench facing North. Maintain persistent visual states for all key objects including the stainless steel sugar caddy, the chrome napkin dispenser, the white ceramic pie plate, and the water glass, ensuring realistic physical weight, match-on-action transitions, and uninterrupted rain streaks on the exterior glass behind the characters.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm motion picture film shot, anamorphic widescreen, cinematic drama, fine film grain.
Palette: Midnight blues, damp asphalt grays, warm diner amber, deep crimson vinyl, faded navy.
Lighting: Cool overhead fluorescent humming tubes mixed with warm interior neon reflections and dark blue rainy exterior light filtering through wet window glass.
Location: Vintage highway diner booth framed by a dark brown wood-grain Formica table, red vinyl bench seats, and a floor-to-ceiling glass window wall covered in heavy rain.
Wardrobe: Robert wears rumpled navy surgical scrubs under an unbuttoned heavy charcoal wool overcoat with a silver wristwatch on his left wrist and graying unbrushed hair; Sarah wears a camel cashmere sweater with cream tailored trousers, gold hoop earrings, a gold signet ring on her right hand, and a dark velvet headband securing a neat low bun; John wears an oversized washed-black waffle-knit sweater with long sleeve cuffs pulled completely over his knuckles, distressed charcoal trousers, and a thin silver chain necklace.
Props: White ceramic pie plate with a half-eaten cherry pie slice, heavy metal fork, stainless steel sugar caddy, chrome napkin dispenser, two white ceramic coffee mugs, tall water glass with ice, small side plate with dried toast, structured black leather handbag.
Audio: Diegetic Foley and ambient audio only including continuous fluorescent light hum, steady rain beating against exterior glass, distant road mist, rubber shoe soles on linoleum, and cutlery scraping against ceramic plates.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
Wide establishing shot from the diner aisle looking West down the center of the booth. Outside the floor-to-ceiling glass wall on the West, heavy rain sheets down against the dark night sky. On the South bench facing North, Robert sits angled inward toward the table, holding a heavy metal fork in his right hand directly over a white ceramic pie plate containing a dried slice of cherry pie. On the North bench facing South, Sarah sits upright on the outer aisle edge with a black handbag in her lap, while John sits hunched in the inner West corner against the wet glass, his forehead hanging low over an untouched white coffee mug. Positioned in the middle of the dark brown Formica table are a chrome napkin dispenser, a stainless steel sugar caddy, a tall glass of cold water, and a small side plate with untouched white toast.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] WS, LOCKOFF, framed along the table axis looking West -> [ACT] Robert drives the heavy metal fork tines vertically down into the dried cherry pie crust, his wrist tensing with effort as the crust resists -> Robert says (grunt) {Left ventricle tissue has more give...} -> <Pastry crust crunching under heavy fork tines> -> [ENV] Rain sheets steadily down the exterior glass behind John in the background
[CAM 02] MS, OTS over Sarah's shoulder facing South toward Robert -> [ACT] Robert twists the fork tines sideways inside the dense pastry while keeping his forearm stiff -> Robert says {...than this crust.} -> <Sharp metal scraping against ceramic plate> -> [ACT] Sarah sits rigid in the foreground, her jaw tightening as she watches his hand movement
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Robert pulls the fork free from the pie slice, shaking his head with a cynical sneer -> Robert says {Honestly.} -> <Metal fork tines clinking against ceramic> -> [ACT] Robert lifts a small bite of pie to his mouth and chews heavily, his jaw clicking once
[CAM 03] MS, OTS over Robert's shoulder facing North toward Sarah -> [ACT] Sarah keeps her eyes fixed on Robert with a stern expression, while John remains motionlessly hunched beside her in the dark corner -> Robert says O.S. (muffled chew) {You'd need a surgical saw...} -> <Soft rhythmic chewing sound> -> [ACT] John's chest rises and falls with a slow, restrained breath
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Robert points the tip of his dirty fork across the Formica table directly toward the chrome napkin dispenser -> Robert says {...just to break the perimeter.} -> Robert drops the heavy metal fork onto the ceramic plate -> <Fork clattering loudly on ceramic surface>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Robert rests his spine against the red vinyl backrest, exhaling a sharp puff of air through his nose while dragging his right palm down his weary face -> Robert says (heavy exhale) {Long hours in the operating room...} -> Robert taps his index finger repeatedly against the outer rim of his pie plate -> <Rhythmic fingernail tapping on ceramic>
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Robert glares down at his pie plate, leaning his upper body forward slightly over the table -> Robert says {...and this is the medical miracle... waiting for me.} -> <Fingernail tapping continues against ceramic rim> -> [ENV] Neon red reflection flickers softly across the Formica surface
[CAM 03] -> [ACT] Sarah places both palms flat on the brown Formica surface, extending her right hand to grip the stainless steel sugar caddy -> Sarah slides the heavy caddy several inches toward the West glass wall, placing it directly between Robert's line of sight and John -> Sarah says {Lower your voice, Robert.} -> <Sugar caddy sliding across Formica surface>
[CAM 04] MCU, side profile of John wedged against the rain window with Sarah's hands visible foreground right -> [ACT] Sarah releases the sugar caddy and folds her hands neatly over her black handbag in her lap while John sits frozen, his jaw muscle pulsing as rain streams outside -> Sarah says O.S. {He's exhausted.} -> <Heavy rain pattering steadily against exterior glass>
[CAM 05] MS, low-angle setup from the aisle space looking inward at the South bench -> [ACT] Robert shifts his hips outward toward the open aisle space, leaning his entire upper torso past the sugar caddy shield to re-establish eye contact with John -> Robert says {We're all exhausted, Sarah.} -> <Leather coat fabric rustling against vinyl backrest>
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Robert rests his chin in his open right hand, his analytical gaze searching the shadowy inner window corner -> Robert says {...That's the baseline.} -> <Fluorescent light humming continuously overhead> -> [ACT] Sarah turns her head slightly to glare at Robert's posture
[CAM 03] -> [ACT] Robert taps his fingernails against his white coffee mug while Sarah sits with compressed lips -> Robert says O.S. {Kid...} -> <Fingernails tapping rhythmically on porcelain mug> -> [ACT] John keeps his head bowed, his eyes fixed on the tabletop
[CAM 04] -> [ACT] John stares blankly ahead without blinking, his waffle-knit sleeve cuffs fully covering his hands, as his father's voice cuts across the table -> Robert says O.S. {...you haven't touched the toast.} -> <Distant wind gust blowing against exterior glass wall>
[CAM 05] -> [ACT] Robert nods subtlely toward the small side plate near John's elbow, leaning further forward over the Formica edge -> Robert says {Or the water. Or... anything.} -> John's jaw muscles pulse twice while he stays wedged motionless against the wet West window wall -> <Continuous low hum of the diner refrigerator compressor>
[</BRIEF>]

II. PART II

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic, continuous drama scene set inside a rainy late-night highway diner, continuing directly from @video1, featuring @actor1 as ROBERT (voice: @audio1), @actor2 as JOHN (voice: @audio2), and @actor3 as SARAH (voice: @audio3), where escalating parental confrontation pushes their silent son to walk out into the storm.
[[/INTENT]]

[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Ensure absolute visual and spatial continuity inheriting directly from @video1, preserving character seating along the East-West booth axis with Robert on the South bench, Sarah on the outer North aisle bench, and John wedged against the West rainy window. Maintain persistent physical states for all table props. Prioritize match-on-action logic and realistic spatial mechanics as John moves out of the tight booth and walks down the diner aisle toward the glass entrance door.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]

[[OPENING]]
Inheriting the final frame of @video1, medium setup from the open aisle space looking inward across the dark brown Formica table. Outside the floor-to-ceiling glass wall on the West, heavy rain sheets down against the night dark. On the South bench facing North, Robert remains seated, leaning his upper body forward around his white coffee mug and pie plate. On the North bench facing South, Sarah sits upright on the outer aisle edge while John stays hunched in the inner window corner, chin hanging low with his hands hidden deep inside his waffle-knit sweater sleeves. On the dark wood table sit the chrome napkin dispenser, stainless steel sugar caddy, tall water glass with ice, and untouched toast plate.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 04] MCU, side profile of John wedged against the rain-streaked West window -> [ACT] John keeps his head bowed, chin tucked low into his collar -> John says (shaky raspy exhale) {I'm fine.} -> <Rain pattering against exterior glass wall> -> [ACT] John stays motionless, staring blankly down at his untouched glass of ice water
[CAM 03] MS, OTS over Robert's shoulder facing North -> [ACT] Sarah turns her upper torso inward toward John, extending her left hand across the dark wood table -> Sarah says {Drink the water, John.} -> <Fabric rustling against wood surface> -> [ACT] Sarah rests her fingertips softly over John's sweater sleeve near his water glass
[CAM 03] -> [ACT] Sarah taps her fingertips twice against John's forearm fabric -> Sarah says (soft pleading tone) {Just three sips.} -> <Fingertips tapping softly on sweater fabric> -> [ACT] Sarah tightens her grip subtly around his wrist
[CAM 03] -> [ACT] Sarah maintains her gentle touch on John's arm -> Sarah says {For me.} -> <Low fluorescent light tube hum> -> [ACT] John's jaw muscle pulses tightly, refusing to look up or reach for the glass
[CAM 02] MS, OTS over Sarah's shoulder facing South toward Robert -> [ACT] Robert shifts his weight forward, pressing his chest closer to the central napkin dispenser -> Robert says {You haven't slept in three days...} -> <Deep nasal inhalation> -> [ACT] Robert narrows his eyes, scrutinizing John's shadowed face across the table
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Robert taps his right forefinger against the Formica wood-grain table surface -> Robert says {...Johnny.} -> <Rhythmic fingernail tapping on wood> -> [ACT] Sarah pulls her shoulders back sharply in reaction to his tone
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Robert points his forefinger subtly toward John -> Robert says (cynical hiss) {Your pupils are pinpricks.} -> <Sharp breath through teeth> -> [ACT] Robert rests his elbow heavily onto the table edge
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Robert shakes his head with clinical detachment -> Robert says {I know what an engine running...} -> <Low hum of ambient refrigerator compressor> -> [ACT] Robert gestures vaguely toward his own chest
[CAM 03] MS, OTS over Robert's shoulder facing North -> [ACT] John stays motionless in the background corner -> Robert says O.S. {...on fumes looks like--} -> <Sudden palm shifting on table> -> [ACT] Sarah snaps her head sharply around, eyes locking onto Robert with intense fury
[CAM 03] -> [ACT] Sarah's brow furrows tightly as she leans over her black leather handbag -> Sarah says (sharp whisper) {Stop diagnosing him.} -> <Leather handbag strap creaking> -> [ACT] John flinches slightly beside her, pulling his chin deeper into his collar
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Robert slams his open right palm flat down onto the table beside his pie plate -> <Heavy thump echoing through diner> -> Robert says (raised authoritative voice) {I'm not diagnosing...} -> [ACT] The tall ice water glass trembles slightly on its paper coaster
[CAM 01] WS, LOCKOFF framed along table axis looking West -> [ACT] Robert draws his spine straight up against the red vinyl backrest, gesturing forcefully to himself -> Robert says {...I'm observing!} -> <Vinyl seat foam compressing under weight> -> [ACT] Sarah stays rigid on her side of the booth, maintaining an icy stare
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Robert opens both hands wide in a defensive posture -> Robert says {I'm allowed to observe my own--} -> <Scrape and heavy metallic thud beneath table> -> [ACT] John's knees hit the underside of the table, shaking the glassware and cutlery
[CAM 05] MS, aisle camera setup looking inward at the North bench -> [ACT] John abruptly shoves his body out from the inner window corner, sliding outward into the open aisle -> <Rattling ice cubes inside water glass> -> [ACT] Sarah quickly draws her legs inward to make space as Robert freezes mid-gesture
[CAM 01] WS looking down the center diner aisle toward the glass entrance door on the East -> [ACT] John stands fully upright in the aisle way, hands jammed deep into his sweater pockets -> John says (flat hollow tone) {I'm waiting in the car.} -> <Heavy ragged exhale> -> [ACT] John turns sharply on his heel without glancing back at his stunned parents
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] John walks briskly down the long diner aisle toward the glass entrance door -> <Rubber shoe soles squeaking against linoleum floor> -> [ACT] In foreground left and right, Sarah slowly lowers her hand onto the table while Robert remains frozen on the South bench
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] John pushes his right palm against the brass push-bar of the front glass door, swinging it open -> <Brass door chime bell ringing twice> -> [ACT] Heavy rain gusts across the open doorway as John steps out alone into the dark storm night
[</BRIEF>]
